title: Mouth Breathing - Chin Support
visual_summary: Fitting a soft chin strap or full face mask to prevent open-mouth air escaping.
narration_summary: If you breathe through your mouth at night A chin support may help reduce dryness and keep therapy on track

start_scene_0_3s.description: Shows mouth dropping open under CPAP pressure.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Applying a chin strap or switching to a full face mask.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Keeps mouth closed to maintain therapeutic pressure.
